questions.stemEn: A child has recurrent pneumococcal infections and now meningitis. Immunoglobulin levels, tetanus antibody response and lymphocyte subsets are normal. Which arm of immunity is most likely defective?
questions.explanationAr: عندما تكون immunoglobulins وvaccine antibody response وlymphocyte subsets طبيعية مع recurrent encapsulated bacterial infections، نفكر في complement defect. Complement يُعد جزءًا من innate immunity.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Humoral immunity ستكون أكثر احتمالًا إذا كان هناك low immunoglobulins أو poor vaccine antibody response. Cellular immunity غالبًا ترتبط opportunistic/viral/fungal infections أكثر.
questions.clinicalPearl: Complement deficiency can present with recurrent invasive infections despite otherwise normal adaptive immune testing.
diagnosticSteps: Screen complement pathway when clinically indicated

questions.stemEn: A child has recurrent meningococcal infection. Which complement abnormality is classically associated with this pattern?
questions.explanationAr: Recurrent Neisseria infection ترفع الشك بشكل كبير في terminal complement pathway deficiency، خصوصًا C5–C9. Properdin deficiency أيضًا قد يسبب meningococcal disease لكنه أقل شيوعًا في أسئلة البورد.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Toll-like receptor defects لها أنماط مختلفة. Properdin deficiency ممكنة لكنها ليست الاختيار الأكثر classic إذا وُجد terminal complement deficiency ضمن الخيارات.
questions.clinicalPearl: Recurrent Neisseria infection is a classic clue to terminal complement deficiency.
diagnosticSteps: Consider CH50/AH50 and targeted complement testing

questions.stemEn: Which complement deficiency most strongly predisposes a child to recurrent Neisseria meningitidis infection?
questions.explanationAr: Terminal complement components C5–C9 تُكوّن membrane attack complex، ونقصها يرتبط بشكل كلاسيكي بـrecurrent Neisseria infections.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Early complement deficiencies قد ترتبط encapsulated infections أو autoimmunity، لكنها ليست الارتباط الكلاسيكي الأقوى مع recurrent meningococcal disease.
questions.clinicalPearl: Think C5–C9 deficiency when meningococcal infections recur.

questions.stemEn: A child has meningococcal meningitis. A recalled option described a terminal-complement gain-of-function mutation as the underlying defect. How should this item be handled?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر نفسه يقول إن wording غير منطقي؛ susceptibility to meningococcal infection ترتبط عادة complement deficiency أو terminal complement inhibition، وليس gain-of-function بالشكل المكتوب. لذلك السؤال لا يُنشر بصيغته الحالية ويحتاج reconstruction من مصدر أقوى.
questions.clinicalPearl: Do not publish a recalled answer when the mechanism conflicts with established immunology.

questions.stemEn: A child has recurrent Staphylococcus aureus infections and deep abscesses. Which primary immunodeficiency is most likely?
questions.explanationAr: Recurrent catalase-positive infections وdeep abscesses، خصوصًا Staphylococcus وfungal infections، من أهم clues لـchronic granulomatous disease بسبب defective oxidative burst.
questions.clinicalPearl: Recurrent staphylococcal abscesses are a classic CGD clue.

tts.text: A child has recurrent Staphylococcus aureus infections and deep abscesses. Which primary immunodeficiency is most likely? Option A, chronic granulomatous disease.

questions.stemEn: A child has recurrent sinopulmonary infections and marked leukocyte abnormalities. Flow cytometry shows absent CD18 expression. What is the diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: CD18 deficiency هو hallmark لـLeukocyte Adhesion Deficiency type I. المرض يتميز recurrent bacterial infections، impaired wound healing، absent pus formation، neutrophilia، وقد يظهر delayed umbilical cord separation.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: CGD سببه defective oxidative burst وليس CD18 deficiency. Hyper-IgE له eczema وcold abscesses ومرتفع IgE لكنه لا يفسر absent CD18.
questions.clinicalPearl: Absent CD18 on flow cytometry strongly supports LAD I.

questions.stemEn: A 10-year-old has failure to thrive, recurrent sinopulmonary infections and Giardia infection. Which immunodeficiency is most likely?
questions.explanationAr: Older child أو adolescent مع recurrent sinopulmonary infections وGiardia مع humoral immune deficiency pattern يناسب CVID. SCID عادة يظهر أبكر وبصورة أشد مع opportunistic infections.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: SCID غالبًا presents in infancy. AIDS يحتاج exposure/risk history وليس هو pattern الكلاسيكي المقصود هنا.
questions.clinicalPearl: Giardiasis plus recurrent respiratory infections in an older child should raise suspicion for a humoral immunodeficiency such as CVID.

questions.stemEn: An 18-month-old boy has recurrent sinopulmonary infections beginning after infancy. All major immunoglobulin classes are low and a brother died young. Which molecular test would confirm the suspected diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: هذا pattern يناسب X-linked agammaglobulinemia (Bruton). السبب mutation في BTK gene، ويظهر بعد انخفاض maternal IgG عادة بعمر 6–18 months مع recurrent bacterial respiratory infections وlow/absent B cells.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: WAS gene يسبب Wiskott-Aldrich. ATM gene يسبب ataxia-telangiectasia.
questions.clinicalPearl: BTK mutation confirms X-linked agammaglobulinemia in the right clinical and immunologic context.

questions.stemEn: A child with agammaglobulinemia develops a viral meningitis pattern on CSF. Which organism is particularly associated with this immunodeficiency?
questions.explanationAr: Patients with X-linked agammaglobulinemia لديهم susceptibility خاصة لـenteroviral infections، وقد يصابون chronic meningoencephalitis بسبب enteroviruses.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Rhinovirus ليس الassociation الكلاسيكي. Cryptococcus يرتبط أكثر severe T-cell dysfunction. H. influenzae يسبب bacterial وليس viral meningitis pattern.
questions.clinicalPearl: Enteroviral CNS infection is a classic complication of severe humoral immunodeficiency.

questions.stemEn: A 6-month-old boy has a severe B-cell immunodeficiency. Which vaccine should be avoided in his household contacts because of transmission risk?
questions.explanationAr: OPV يمكن أن shed vaccine virus في stool، لذلك يُتجنب عند household contacts لمريض immunocompromised ويُستخدم IPV بدلًا منه. MMR وvaricella عادة يمكن إعطاؤهما للمخالط السليم حسب الإرشادات، مع احتياطات محددة إذا ظهر rash بعد varicella vaccine.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: MMR وVaricella ليستا contraindicated بشكل روتيني للمخالط السليم فقط بسبب وجود immunocompromised household member. Hepatitis A inactivated vaccine.
questions.clinicalPearl: Avoid OPV in close contacts of severely immunocompromised patients; use IPV instead.
